cards.title: A blessed birth in Makkah
cards.body: Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born in Makkah. Muslims love and respect him as the final Messenger of Allah. We say ﷺ (sallallahu alayhi wa sallam) when we hear his name.
cards.source: Qur'an 33:40 — he is the Messenger of Allah and the Seal of the Prophets

cards.title: His loving family
cards.body: His father was Abdullah ibn Abdul Muttalib, and his mother was Aminah bint Wahb. He was from the noble tribe of Quraysh. After his parents passed away when he was young, his grandfather and then his uncle Abu Talib cared for him with kindness.
cards.source: Seerah founded on authentic reports; lineage noted in sirah works drawing from early Islamic history (Ibn Ishaq / Ibn Hisham tradition)

cards.title: Al-Amin — the Trustworthy
cards.body: Even before prophethood, people of Makkah called him Al-Amin because he was honest and trustworthy. When we tell the truth and keep promises, we follow his beautiful example.
cards.source: Authentic seerah reports preserved by early historians; honesty of the Prophet ﷺ is mutawatir in meaning across hadith literature

cards.title: Some of his blessed names
cards.body: Among his names and titles: Muhammad (the praised one), Ahmad, Al-Mustafa (the chosen), and Rasul Allah (Messenger of Allah). The Qur’an also mentions him as a mercy to the worlds.
cards.source: Qur'an 61:6 (Ahmad); Qur'an 33:40 (Muhammad, Messenger); Qur'an 21:107 (mercy to the worlds); Sahih Muslim 2354 (names of the Prophet ﷺ)

cards.title: Marriage to Khadijah (RA)
cards.body: He married Khadijah bint Khuwaylid (RA), a noble and kind woman. She believed in him first and supported him with love. Together they had children including Fatimah (RA).
cards.source: Sahih Bukhari 3821 (Khadijah’s virtues); established authentic seerah regarding early support of Khadijah (RA)

cards.title: His children
cards.body: From Khadijah (RA) he had sons Qasim and Abdullah (who died young) and daughters Zaynab, Ruqayyah, Umm Kulthum, and Fatimah (RA). Later he also had a son Ibrahim. We speak about them gently and with respect.
cards.source: Established authentic seerah summaries; Sahih Bukhari 6191 ( Ibrahim ); daughters widely reported in authentic collections

cards.title: The first revelation
cards.body: In the cave of Hira, Angel Jibril brought the first words of the Qur’an: “Read!” This began his mission to teach people about Allah, kindness, and truth.

cards.title: The Hijrah to Madinah
cards.body: When life in Makkah became very hard for the Muslims, Allah allowed the Prophet ﷺ and his companions to migrate to Madinah. This special journey is called the Hijrah. It teaches patience, trust in Allah, and starting fresh with hope.

cards.title: A heart full of kindness
cards.body: He was gentle with children, fair with neighbours, and merciful to all. He taught that the strong person controls anger, and that smiling can be a charity.
cards.source: Sahih Bukhari 6114 (strong is who controls anger); Sahih Muslim 2323 (kindness); Jami' at-Tirmidhi 1956 (smiling as charity — hasan)

cards.title: The final Messenger
cards.body: Allah sent many prophets. Prophet Muhammad ﷺ is the last Messenger. We follow the Qur’an and his authentic teachings (Sunnah) to live good, happy lives.
